newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius shares rise ahead of Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius shares rise ahead of Christmas.

text.p: Shares at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius were bolstered on Friday by investors completing their deals before the Christmas period lull, brokers said.
The SEMDEX market index rose 3.68 points to 341.86 and volume totalled 10.39 million rupees on 480,643 shares from 14.20 million rupees on 594,170 shares on Wednesday.
"Next week is Christmas and many of investors will have their minds elsewhere. Most of them prefer to complete their deals before the end of year festivities," one broker said.
Shares were mostly on the rise on Friday with volume well spread across the board.
"This shows a general upward trend. The stock exchange is on course to end the year on a good note," the broker added.
Mauritius Commercial Bank gained 50 cents to 76 rupees on 27,202 shares and State Bank of Mauritius climbed 20 cents to an all-time high of 9.60 rupees on 78,850 shares.
Construction-based Gamma Civic surged 80 cents to 16.50 rupees on 20,000 shares. Consolidated Investment Trust edged up by 10 cents to 9.40 rupees on 62,450 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert was 30 cents up to 38.70 rupees on 1,600 shares.

Conglomerate Rogers was 50 cents higher to 95 rupees on 20,429 shares. Commerce-based Courts was up 20 cents to 4.70 rupees on 1,000 shares and Happy World Foods rose 30 cents to 17.50 rupees on 112,731 shares.
Hotel stocks Sun Resorts was 50 cents higher to 37 rupees on 3,659 shares and New Mauritius Hotels was 50 cents up to 30.50 rupees on 1,500 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged at 50 rupees on 6,750 shares.
